queer_characters.name: Luz Noceda
queer_characters.notes: Creator Dana Terrace confirmed Luz is bisexual in a Sept 2020 Reddit AMA; a promotional short shows her with a bisexual pride flag pin and a finale special shows her coming out to her mother.

queer_characters.name: Amity Blight
queer_characters.notes: Confirmed lesbian; her romance with Luz was confirmed by Terrace in 2020 and the pair share an on-screen kiss in 'Clouds on the Horizon' (2022).

queer_characters.name: Raine Whispers
queer_characters.notes: Uses singular they/them pronouns on screen and is described in show notes as Disney TV Animation's first transgender and/or nonbinary character; voiced by trans nonbinary actor Avi Roque. Formerly involved with Eda Clawthorne.

queer_characters.name: Lilith Clawthorne
queer_characters.notes: Described as aromantic and asexual in the provided material.

queer_characters.name: Masha
queer_characters.notes: A camp attendee described as nonbinary.

queer_characters.name: Hunter
queer_characters.notes: Confirmed bisexual post-finale according to the source material.

queer_characters.name: Willow Park's fathers
queer_characters.notes: Willow has two dads; the source describes them as a family unit but does not label their identities explicitly, so gay is inferred.

queer_creators.name: Avi Roque
queer_creators.notes: Publicly identified transgender and nonbinary actor who voices Raine Whispers.

contributor_notes: First Disney property to feature a same-sex couple in leading roles (Luz and Amity); won a 2021 Peabody Award and earned GLAAD nominations. Willow's fathers' specific identities are inferred, not stated in the source. Human maintainer should verify episode titles and post-finale confirmations.
